question: What was the position of the circuits during Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap in a Formula_1 race?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "hamilton_fastest_lap_positions" AS WITH hamilton AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverid
  FROM table_1
  WHERE lower(attribute) = 'driverref' AND lower(value) = 'hamilton'
), h_fast AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceid,
    r.driverid,
    CAST(r.fastestlap AS INTEGER) AS lap_number,
    r.fastestlaptime,
    r.fastestlapspeed
  FROM table_11 r
  JOIN hamilton h ON h.driverid = r.driverid
  WHERE r.fastestlap IS NOT NULL AND r.rank = 1
), h_lap_pos AS (
  SELECT
    f.raceid,
    f.driverid,
    f.lap_number,
    f.fastestlaptime,
    f.fastestlapspeed,
    lt.position AS driver_position_on_lap
  FROM h_fast f
  JOIN table_2 lt
    ON lt.raceid = f.raceid
   AND lt.driverid = f.driverid
   AND lt.lap = f.lap_number
)
SELECT
  hlp.raceid,
  ra.year,
  ra.round,
  ra.name AS grand_prix,
  c.name AS circuit_name,
  c.location AS circuit_location,
  c.country,
  hlp.lap_number,
  hlp.driver_position_on_lap,
  hlp.fastestlaptime AS fastest_lap_time,
  hlp.fastestlapspeed AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM h_lap_pos hlp
JOIN table_10 ra ON ra.raceid = hlp.raceid
JOIN table_3 c ON c.circuitid = ra.circuitid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  year,
  round,
  grand_prix,
  circuit_name,
  country,
  lap_number,
  driver_position_on_lap AS position_on_fastest_lap,
  fastest_lap_time,
  fastest_lap_speed
FROM hamilton_fastest_lap_positions
ORDER BY year DESC, round DESC
LIMIT 10

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS total_events,
  'No Hamilton fastest-lap events found in the integrated dataset; likely fastestlap or lap_times link missing.' AS note
